mapper.select: SELECT subject_id, login_name, password_hash, status, version, created_at FROM organization_access.subject_identity WHERE subject_id = #{subjectId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM organization_access.platform_role_binding WHERE subject_id = #{subjectId} AND role_code = 'PLATFORM_ADMINISTRATOR' AND status = 'ACTIVE')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM organization_access.platform_role_binding binding INNER JOIN organization_access.subject_identity subject ON subject.subject_id = binding.subject_id WHERE binding.role_code = 'PLATFORM_ADMINISTRATOR' AND binding.status = 'ACTIVE' AND subject.status = 'ACTIVE' AND binding.subject_id <> #{subjectId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO organization_access.subject_identity (subject_id, login_name, password_hash, status, version, created_at) VALUES (#{subjectId}, #{loginName}, #{passwordHash}, #{status}, #{version}, #{createdAt}) ON CONFLICT (login_name) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE organization_access.subject_identity SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, status = #{status}, version = #{version}, updated_at = CASE WHEN password_hash <> #{passwordHash} OR status <> #{status} THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE updated_at END WHERE subject_id = #{subjectId} AND version = #{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT subject.subject_id, subject.login_name, subject.status, subject.version, subject.created_at, subject.updated_at, binding.role_code AS active_role_codes FROM organization_access.subject_identity subject INNER JOIN organization_access.platform_role_binding binding ON binding.subject_id = subject.subject_id AND binding.role_code = 'PLATFORM_ADMINISTRATOR' AND binding.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE (#{loginName} = '' OR POSITION(LOWER(#{loginName}) IN LOWER(subject.login_name)) > 0) AND (#{status} = 'ALL' OR subject.status = #{status}) ORDER BY subject.created_at DESC, subject.subject_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO organization_access.platform_account_operation_audit (operator_subject_id, target_subject_id, operation, result, target_version) VALUES (#{operatorSubjectId}, #{targetSubjectId}, #{operation}, 'SUCCEEDED', #{targetVersion})
